ig_caption:
What is a skill in AI? It's just a folder 📁

Inside:
📄 SKILL.md: front matter (a name + when to use it), then plain instructions
📚 optional extras: reference docs, templates, even scripts the agent can run

No training. No fine-tuning. Just written know-how the agent picks up when it needs it.
That's why skills spread so fast: anyone who knows the job can write one.
